summary: Frontend-only E2E test of the simplified Hub tab and the new /my-profile page on the preview URL (admin forest@imosapp.com). Verified Hub layout (profile card, 2 buttons, search bar, 6-tile task grid, 8 accordions with count pills), hub search filtering + result navigation, all 6 task tile destinations, everyday accordions (Partner Portal/Manage/My Tools/Campaigns/My Performance/Learning/Settings), the single Admin accordion with 3 sub-group labels (37 items = 9+12+16), full My Profile page (5 public page cards with Share/Send/View/Edit, MY CONTENT rows, Edit My Info, VA, back nav), and regressions on Home/Contacts/Inbox + thread message rendering (MessageBubble refactor) with header search. Core functionality is intact — no functional regressions found in the changed screens. 3 medium issues found (all outside the new UI logic: preview routing of /inbox, hardcoded prod base URL for public links, review-link slug resolution for users without store_id).

ui_bugs.issue: Profile photo asset is a 1x1 px webp (94 bytes) served from /api/images/imos/profiles/...thumb.webp, so the avatar renders as a solid olive block on Hub, My Profile and My Account. Cover photo is only 100x100 upscaled to full width (blurry). PRE-EXISTING (same on /my-account), not caused by this change.

data-testid props do not reach the DOM (only 'theme-toggle-home' was found). Every documented testid (hub-search-input, task-*, section-header-admin-hub, profile-page-*, content-*) is absent, so automation must rely on text selectors. Consider dataSet={{testid:'x'}} which RNW emits as data-testid.
Repeated console error: 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>' — stray whitespace/JSX text node inside a View. Harmless but noisy.

integration_issues.issue: Loading https://<preview>/inbox directly returns the imonsocial MARKETING page ('INBOX & MESSAGING … Book a Demo'), not the app inbox. Navigating via the bottom tab bar works fine (28 conversations, filters, threads). /home, /contacts, /more, /my-profile, /thread/* direct URLs are unaffected — looks like a marketing-service/ingress route conflict on /inbox.

my-profile.tsx hardcodes PROD_BASE='https://app.imonsocial.com' for all 5 public links. On preview, View opens https://app.imonsocial.com/card/<id>?self_preview=1 which renders 'Card Not Found' (preview data does not exist in prod). Share copies the same prod URL. Should read process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_URL (already in frontend/.env).

storeSlug is only resolved via GET /admin/stores/{store_id}; for the super-admin (no store_id) no request is fired at all, so the card permanently shows 'Store slug not set — tap Edit to configure' and has no Share/Send/View buttons. more.tsx additionally fell back to user.store_slug (line ~135) — that fallback is missing on the new page.

issues: The 4 action chips wrap so 'Edit' drops to its own line on each card — slightly ragged but readable
No page title in the header; only a floating back chevron over the cover
Notification bell badge sits on top of the profile-card cover's top-right corner
Cover/avatar images are heavily upscaled (see avatar bug)

action_items: Investigate why direct navigation to /inbox on the preview host serves the marketing site instead of the Expo app (in-app tab nav works)
Replace hardcoded PROD_BASE in /app/frontend/app/my-profile.tsx with process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_URL so Share/View links are environment-correct
Add a store-slug fallback (user.store_slug / org lookup) on my-profile Review Link card so users without store_id still get a review link, matching old Hub behaviour
Optional: emit real data-testid attributes on RN Web (dataSet) to make future automated testing reliable
critical_code_review_comments: my-profile.tsx: PROD_BASE hardcoded ('https://app.imonsocial.com') — violates env-var rule and breaks link previews outside prod
my-profile.tsx: no loading/error state for the GET /admin/stores/{store_id} call (.catch(() => {}) silently swallows failures)
(tabs)/more.tsx is 2373 lines — well above the 700-line guideline; sections config, search index and modals should be extracted
Hub search index dedupes by title only, so two different items with the same title would silently hide one (currently only 'Partner Portal' collides between section and admin item)

success_rate.frontend: ~93% (all Hub/My Profile/regression flows pass; 3 medium integration issues)

seed_data_creation: None — navigation-only testing, no broadcasts/SMS sent, no data modified
context_for_next_testing_agent: data-testid does NOT reach the DOM on this Expo-web app — use text/placeholder selectors. Hub search input: input[placeholder*='Search anything']. Section headers/accordion items are plain text (get_by_text exact=True, .first). Text with textTransform:uppercase in CSS still has original-case DOM text (e.g. 'Sales Director' not 'SALES DIRECTOR'). Hidden tab screens (Home) stay mounted and intercept clicks — scope clicks to unique visible text. Thread header icons are icon-font DIVs (no svg): search icon is the leftmost right-side glyph (~x=1758,y=33 at 1920 width); thread search bar placeholder is 'Search this conversation…' and highlighting works (5/5 for 'holiday'). /inbox must be reached by clicking the Inbox tab; direct URL serves the marketing site.
rca_of_the_issue: Review-link gap: my-profile.tsx resolves storeSlug only from GET /admin/stores/{user.store_id} and returns early when store_id is falsy, so super-admin/individual users never get a review URL; the old Hub code also checked user.store_slug first. Public-link 'Card Not Found': PROD_BASE is hardcoded to app.imonsocial.com so preview-only records are looked up in production. /inbox marketing page: the request is served by the marketing service rather than the Expo dev server, so it never reaches the app router.
